bibl.title: Anastasia, Thecla, and Friends. Archaeological and Epigraphic Evidence from the Shenoutean Women's Monastery at Atripe.
bibl.seg: Stephen J. Davis, Anastasia, Thecla, and Friends. Archaeological and Epigraphic Evidence from the Shenoutean Women's Monastery at Atripe.
bibl.note: 1. Introduction. - 2. Archaeological evidence: the Refectory and the Six-Pillared Hall. - 3. Names written on walls: a prosopographical record of monastic women. - 4. Food matters: evidence for the administration of goods at the women's monastery. - 5. Conclusion: the survival of the women's monastery after Shenoute.
